items.rationale: A fixed, permanently wired AC unit is a building component. It is covered under 2.3.3 if the surge was lightning-induced overvoltage; the description says only 'power surge', which creates doubt. Like-for-like replacement is priced at the reference level (cases 38/42).
Labour of putting a covered replacement unit in place follows the principal item (7.1.11). Priced at the reference level of about 480.

An equivalent stand replacing a damaged console is indemnified as part of the like-for-like replacement (case 38). It would be excluded as new equipment under 7.1.9(a) if it did not replace a damaged console, so coverage is uncertain.
Freight is an ancillary charge that follows its covered principal item (7.1.11). Priced at the reference level of about 43.
